EC1: Having significant medical illnesses that would interfere with the conduct of the study
EC3: Having comorbid psychiatric conditions according to the criteria set forth in the DSM-IV(administered by the Mini-International Neuropsychiatric Interview (MINI))
EC4: The current OCD symptoms are too severe that the patient cannot finish the evaluation or receive the ERP
EC5: Being currently at risk for suicide
EC6: Being pregnant or having the intention to be pregnant before the end of the study
EC7: A history of having inadequate response to adequate SSRIs or CB [OR]T treatment
EC8: Subjects who are unable to undergo the MRI
